posts.text:
Mike Rowe surprises Bill Maher with a personal story about President Trump.

It involved a signed bathrobe that was auctioned off for charity, but the real story was what Rowe said it revealed about Trump’s character.

Maher listened intently as Rowe explained what happened after his show was pulled from CNN 11 years ago.

Rowe reached out to the three frontrunners in the 2016 presidential election and asked each of them to donate something he could auction off for his scholarship fund.

ROWE: “And then I wrote something on Facebook to Hillary, Bernie and Donald Trump, who were all the reason that Jeff (Zucker) threw my show to the side.”

“I said, look guys, I’ve been canceled. You can repent, because it’s your fault by donating something that I can auction off to raise some money for my scholarship fund.”

“I said Bernie, send me one of your crumpley blazers, or Hillary send me a pantsuit...”

“I said to Trump, send me, I don’t know, send me a pair of autographed slippers from one of your hotels or a robe or something.”

“I didn’t expect to hear anything from anybody.”

“Three days later, hand-delivered, signed bathrobe from Donald Trump.”

Rowe told Maher that the bathrobe eventually brought in $34,000 at auction for his scholarship fund.

The money wasn’t even the point...Rowe explained what stuck with him most about the whole thing. 

ROWE: “I couldn’t believe it got to him, and when it did get to him, I couldn’t believe he said yeah, why not?”

“Like somehow he found time.”

This small gesture really left a lasting impression on Rowe. 

Maher got to hear a personal story about Trump that you rarely hear in the media.

He looked genuinely impressed by the end of it.

You do not have to save your family from marauders or go into battle to destroy your enemies. You have to sit down and learn from someone who cares about you in a safe, air-conditioned room.
